VLAN

Select a VLAN mode for your switch. (One from the below options)

  • NO VLANS

    No VLANs are applied in this mode.

  • Basic Port-Based VLAN

    Group ports together simply by port number.

  • Advanced Port-Based VLAN

    Each port can join multiple VLAN groups.

  • Basic 802.1Q VLAN

    Configure VLAN with Access / Trunk Mode.

  • Advanced 802.1Q VLAN

    Group ports together by port number with 802.1Q and Voice VLAN parameters.

    (Current Mode)

802.1Q-BASED PORT CONFIGURATION

If the port connects to an end device such as a PC or gaming device, then set up the port as an access port. If the port connects to a VLAN device such as a switch, then set up as a trunk port.
